verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both are broken the same way. 'Should You' has been pulled out of the headline stack and dropped onto the busy hand and bottle photo, where it is hard to read and reads out of order. The '=' rules and dashed lines that framed it are scattered and stranded above 'Drink Water', the zigzags collide with the yellow ribbon, and the ribbon tails run into the right edge, so the original's centred title lockup no longer holds together.
